Runtime capture context, account update message, buffer sizing, and lifecycle and txn status lock APIs.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_capture_ctx` data structure used by the runtime to manage capture and checkpoint features during transaction execution. It also defines `fd_capture_ctx_account_update_msg_t`, which is the packed message format used to send account update data from the exec tile to the replay tile, along with size and buffer limits for account update storage. The `fd_capture_ctx_t` structure stores Solcap capture state, checkpoint settings, protobuf dump options, and a buffer for account update messages. The file also declares the memory layout helpers and lifecycle functions [`fd_capture_ctx_new`](<#fd_capture_ctx_new>), [`fd_capture_ctx_join`](<#fd_capture_ctx_join>), [`fd_capture_ctx_leave`](<#fd_capture_ctx_leave>), and [`fd_capture_ctx_delete`](<#fd_capture_ctx_delete>), plus lock helpers for transaction status access.
